info.name: Phase 2 - Page-Section System
info.description:
Comprehensive testing for Phase 2: Page Tree Management, Section Management, Section Types, and Public API

**Prerequisites:**
- Phase 1 completed (users and tokens captured)
- Backend server running
- MongoDB connected

**Test Coverage:**
- Section Types (seed, CRUD, usage tracking)
- Page Tree Management (hierarchy, moving, reordering)
- Section Management (all section types, validation)
- Public API (published content only)

**Expected Runtime:** ~3 minutes
